SELECT a.warn_id, a.warn_time as alarm_time, a.device_id, b.device_name, a.warn_level as alarm_level, c.dict_note as alarm_level_name, a.conf_mode, e.dict_note as conf_mode_name, a.alarm_source, d.dict_note as alarm_source_name from t_warn_info a left join t_std_device b on a.device_id = b.device_id left join t_dict_business c on a.warn_level = c.dict_code left join t_dict_business d on a.alarm_source = d.dict_code left join t_dict_business e on a.conf_mode = e.dict_code where 1 = 1 and a.warn_level = #{alarmLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.conf_mode = #{confMode, jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.alarm_source = #{alarmSource, jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.device_id in (select device_id from t_std_device where device_name like concat("%",#{deviceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},"%")) and a.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND #{endTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and a.device_id in
#{deviceId,jdbcType=BIGINT}

select f.robot_alarm_id as warnId, f.alarm_time as warnTime, f.alarm_info as value, f.robot_id as deviceId, g.robot_name as deviceName, f.robot_id as alarmSource, f.alarm_level as warnLevel, f.alarm_state as confMode, c.dict_note as warnLevelName, g.robot_name as alarmSourceName, e.dict_note as confModeName from robot_alarm f left join t_dict_business c on f.alarm_level = c.dict_code left join t_dict_business e on f.alarm_state = e.dict_code left join t_robot_info g on f.robot_id = g.robot_id where 1=1 and f.alarm_level = #{warnLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER} and f.alarm_state = #{confMode, jdbcType=INTEGER} and f.alarm_info like concat("%",#{value, jdbcType=INTEGER},"%") and f.alarm_time BETWEEN #{startTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND #{endTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and a.alarm_type = #{warnType, jdbcType=INTEGER}

select h.alarm_no as warn_id, h.alarm_time, b.device_id, b.device_name, h.alarm_level, c.dict_note as alarm_level_name, h.is_clear as conf_mode, e.dict_note as conf_mode_name from t_cfg_alarm_current h left join t_std_device b on h.device_id = b.device_id left join t_dict_business e on h.is_clear = e.dict_code left join t_dict_business c on h.alarm_level = c.dict_code where 1=1 and h.alarm_level = #{alarmLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER} and h.is_clear = #{confMode, jdbcType=INTEGER} and b.device_id in (select device_id from t_std_device where device_name like concat("%",#{deviceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},"%")) and h.alarm_time BETWEEN #{startTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND #{endTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.warn_id, a.warn_time as alarm_time, a.warn_content, a.device_id, b.device_name, a.warn_level as alarm_level, c.dict_note as alarm_level_name, a.conf_mode, e.dict_note as conf_mode_name, a.alarm_source, d.dict_note as alarm_source_name from t_warn_info a left join t_std_device b on a.device_id = b.device_id left join t_dict_business c on a.warn_level = c.dict_code left join t_dict_business d on a.alarm_source = d.dict_code left join t_dict_business e on a.conf_mode = e.dict_code where 1 = 1 union all( select h.camera_alarm_id as warn_id, h.alarm_time, h.alarm_name as warn_content, h.camera_id, b.camera_name, h.alarm_level, c.dict_note as alarm_level_name, h.alarm_state as conf_mode, e.dict_note as conf_mode_name, 888 as alarm_source, 'visual' as alarm_source_name from t_camera_alarm h left join t_camera_info b on h.camera_id = b.camera_id left join t_dict_business e on h.alarm_state = e.dict_code left join t_dict_business c on h.alarm_level = c.dict_code where 1 = 1 ) union all( select f.robot_alarm_id as warn_id, f.alarm_time, f.alarm_name as warn_content, f.robot_id as deviceId, g.robot_name as device_name, f.alarm_level, c.dict_note as alarm_level_name, f.alarm_state as conf_mode, e.dict_note as conf_mode_name, 279 as alarm_source, '机器人' as alarm_source_name from t_robot_alarm f left join t_dict_business c on f.alarm_level = c.dict_code left join t_dict_business e on f.alarm_state = e.dict_code left join t_robot_info g on f.robot_id = g.robot_id where 1 = 1 ) ) big_table where 1 = 1 and alarm_level = #{warnLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER} and conf_mode = #{confMode, jdbcType=INTEGER} and device_id in (select device_id from t_std_device where device_name like concat("%",#{deviceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},"%")) and alarm_time BETWEEN #{startTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND #{endTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}

select COUNT(alarm_time BETWEEN #{firstTime2} and #{firstTime1} or null) as #{firstTime1}, COUNT(alarm_time BETWEEN #{firstTime3} and #{firstTime2} or null) as #{firstTime2}, COUNT(alarm_time BETWEEN #{firstTime4} and #{firstTime3} or null) as #{firstTime3}, COUNT(alarm_time BETWEEN #{firstTime5} and #{firstTime4} or null) as #{firstTime4}, COUNT(alarm_time BETWEEN #{firstTime6} and #{firstTime5} or null) as #{firstTime5}, COUNT(alarm_time BETWEEN #{firstTime7} and #{firstTime6} or null) as #{firstTime6}, COUNT(alarm_time BETWEEN #{firstTime8} and #{firstTime7} or null) as #{firstTime7} from robot_alarm

select dict_code as device_type, dict_note as device_type_name, (select COUNT(*) from t_std_device a,t_warn_info b where a.device_id = b.device_id and device_type = dict_code ) as "count" from t_dict_business where dict_code in ( select dict_code from t_dict_business where col_name = 'device_type' ) ORDER BY dict_code

select a.defect_id, a.defect_time, a.device_id, b.device_name, a.defect_type, a.deal_info, a.conf_mode, d.dict_note as conf_mode_name, a.deal_time FROM t_defect_info a LEFT JOIN t_std_device b on a.device_id = b.device_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business d on d.dict_code = a.conf_mode

SELECT a.countNum as '主设备', b.countNum as '机器人', d.countNum as '摄像机', (a.countNum+b.countNum+d.countNum) as '总告警数' FROM( (select count(*) as countNum from t_warn_info ) a, (select count(*) as countNum from t_robot_alarm ) b, (select count(*) as countNum from t_camera_alarm) d )

SELECT a.processed+b.processed+d.processed as '已处理', e.untreated+f.untreated+g.untreated as '未处理' FROM ( (select count(conf_mode = 275 or null) as processed from t_warn_info ) a, (select count(alarm_state = 275 or null) as processed from t_robot_alarm ) b, (select count(alarm_state = 275 or null) as processed from t_camera_alarm) d, (select count(conf_mode = 276 or null) as untreated from t_warn_info ) e, (select count(alarm_state = 276 or null) as untreated from t_robot_alarm ) f, (select count(alarm_state = 276 or null) as untreated from t_camera_alarm) g )

SELECT DATE_FORMAT( alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) time, count( * ) count FROM ( select h.alarm_time from t_cfg_alarm_history h where 1=1 and h.alarm_level = #{warnLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER} and h.alarm_desc like concat("%",#{value, jdbcType=INTEGER},"%") and h.alarm_time BETWEEN #{startTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND #{endTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and h.warn_type = #{warnType, jdbcType=INTEGER} ) AS Time WHERE period_diff( date_format( now( ) , '%Y-%m-%d' ) , date_format( alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) ) =0 GROUP BY time

SELECT DATE_FORMAT( alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) time, count( * ) count FROM ( select f.alarm_time from robot_alarm f where 1=1 and f.alarm_level = #{warnLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER} and f.alarm_state = #{confMode, jdbcType=INTEGER} and f.alarm_info like concat("%",#{value, jdbcType=INTEGER},"%") and f.alarm_time BETWEEN #{startTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND #{endTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and a.alarm_type = #{warnType, jdbcType=INTEGER} ) AS Time WHERE period_diff( date_format( now( ) , '%Y-%m-%d' ) , date_format( alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) ) =0 GROUP BY time
